about.name: Akrisht Kaul
bio: Whether it's building a full-stack web app, writing safety-critical firmware for a race car, or shipping an AI feature, I love taking ideas from concept to reality. My foundation in software engineering spans full-stack development, backend systems, and low-level embedded work, and I'm just as comfortable building close to the hardware as I am building on top of it.
about.personalNote: When I'm not coding or sketching circuits, you'll find me making music, breakdancing, or grappling with my sparring mates.
assistantContext: Rising junior as of Fall 2026 (freshman year at Boston University, then transferred to Columbia).
Collaborative and outgoing, and works well in team settings.
My favorite color is blue, and I love studying and food crawling in NYC.
Some things I like to do for fun: play guitar, play piano, sing, edit videos, breakdance, Brazilian jiu-jitsu, and host parties.
I have a strong interest in AI and machine learning, and I enjoy exploring new technologies and frameworks.
Favorite artists: Malcolm Todd, Daniel Caesar, and Bruno Mars.
currentlyWorkingOn: Designing the hardware for the FSAE car's dashboard, with a focus on a clean UI.
Scoping the next phase of WasteWise and researching disposal-rule sourcing.

items.name: Ad Automation Platform
items.description: Production backend for an AI-driven ad platform automating multi-channel campaign deployment for small businesses.
details: Closed 5 prod-reachable vulnerabilities across 42 endpoints and cut boilerplate 90% by centralizing scattered servlet logic into a policy and hash map dispatch layer, enforced via pre-commit hooks
Cut hiring software costs by $8K/year by building an in-house ATS with role-specific assessments and AI-generated-response detection, designed to scale to 3,000 applications annually
Removed manual per-location uploads and engineering involvement from franchise onboarding by shipping a self-serve tool publishing 500 posts across 50 locations per batch

items.name: Battery Management System Firmware
items.description: Safety-critical embedded firmware for a high-voltage battery management system on a Formula SAE race car.
details: Developed embedded C/C++ firmware on an STM32G4 for a safety-critical high-voltage BMS, monitoring 14 battery cells via the ADBMS6830 over SPI and coordinating 6 concurrent timed tasks for sensing, balancing, contactor control, and real-time fault monitoring
Achieved 10 ms contactor response and 100 ms CAN fault broadcast latency
Diagnosed and eliminated a critical SPI hang in the ADBMS6830 driver that could freeze the entire BMS loop indefinitely, replacing HAL_MAX_DELAY with a 500 ms timeout for fail-safe recovery

items.name: WasteWise
items.description: Mobile app helping Town of Hempstead residents navigate area-specific rules for disposing of electronics, furniture, and bulk waste items.
details: Building a mobile app that helps Town of Hempstead residents determine how to properly dispose of different waste types (electronics, furniture, bulk items) based on area-specific rules, letting users look up disposal guidelines, book pickups, and manage requests in one localized place

items.name: FitBro
items.description: Full-stack AI fitness trainer with RAG-based chat that retrieves workout history to deliver personalized advice.
details: Built a full-stack AI fitness trainer with RAG-based chat that retrieves workout history to deliver personalized advice via GPT-4o mini
Integrated a 1,300+ exercise library with auto-save persistence and real-time search

items.name: StonksGPT
items.description: Agentic trading copilot that makes stock trading approachable through voice-driven LLM tool execution.
details: Built an agentic trading copilot where users interact via voice with an LLM that executes trades, tracks portfolios, and delivers real-time market news
Prevented hallucinations through structured audit trails, validated across 50+ test trades

items.name: Storage Buddy Platform
items.description: Full-stack internship through Columbia Business School on a storage marketplace platform incubated there.
details: Built a real-time messaging system with sub-second delivery across text, images, and documents, with profanity filtering, PII masking, and user blocking for 50+ users across Boston and NYC
Migrated the core platform from Bubble.io to a React/Supabase stack, reducing no-code dependency and enabling custom feature development across a 4-person team

items.name: Add Up Cafe
items.description: Classroom management platform with gamified learning, built for a special-education environment.
details: Built and deployed a full-stack classroom management platform with role-based user flows, assignment tracking, and gamified learning features
Iterated directly with a special-education teacher and 15 students in a live classroom to refine UX and feature reliability

items.name: What Makes Songs Pop
items.description: Statistical analysis of 114K songs to identify the drivers of music popularity.
details: Analyzed 114K songs across 114 genres using linear regression and K-means clustering
Found instrumentalness to be the strongest single predictor (r = -0.095), and that the high-energy cluster produces 60% of top-1% hits despite lower average popularity

items.name: Ground Support Dashboard
items.description: Real-time ground support equipment dashboard for static-fire testing.
details: Designed a Flask ground support dashboard for rocket engine testing, streaming 20+ sensor and actuator channels at 20 Hz over WebSockets and marking any channel silent for 5s as disconnected instead of showing stale readings
Sent a heartbeat to 4 firmware controllers every 2.5s so they could detect a lost connection and automatically shut off valves and ignition without operator input

items.name: Object Detection Pipeline
items.description: Computer vision pipeline for real-time object detection under rover hardware constraints.
details: Built a Python computer vision pipeline using YOLOv8 and OpenCV, creating and classifying a custom dataset from scratch to reach 85% real-time detection accuracy
Refined bounding boxes and optimized inference via quantization for resource-limited rover hardware

items.name: Kenya Borehole Project
items.description: Fundraising and outreach for a clean water borehole project in Kenya.
details: Raised $4,000+ through public events for the Kenya borehole project
Led workshops and STEM outreach to engage students in science and engineering

items.name: HTS Wire Harness PCB
items.description: Custom PCB for a horizontal test stand, taken from schematic through fabrication.
details: Created a full Altium schematic through Gerber output with custom footprints and DRC compliance
Coordinated fabrication and achieved first-pass success with zero defects
